lines.en: [CASE['victim']]

lines.label: case_file
lines.en: [_lines]

lines.label: case_file
lines.en: Three keys. Three people. Twelve questions before the captain takes it off you.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: Nobody told you he was in the cooler.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: The file says the office. The press says the office. Your own statement says you never went past the bar. And then you told me it was cold in there.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: Vee looks at their hands as though the hands were the part that did it.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: He was already going. I only moved him so she wouldn't be the one to find him.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: They take the shoe out from under the bottom rack at 06:40. Left foot. Size ten.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: You clear the case with [questions_left] questions still on the board, which nobody will notice, and one door you closed, which you will.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: The bay water is rain and diesel. Iris had neither in her.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: You told me the mop room sink is the only clean basin in the building. The file doesn't say clean. Nobody said clean but you.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: She does not look away. She has not once looked away in three nights, and that is the worst of it.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: She was going to hand me to an auditor and call it a kindness. Six years, and she thought the kind thing was to warn me it was coming.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: So you carried her out to the car.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: I put her somewhere she would be found by a stranger. That was the kindness I had left.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: The bay light is on a timer. It has been off for three weeks and nobody has called it in, because nobody in this building calls anything in.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: [questions_left] questions still on the board. She signs the statement herself, on every page, the way she has signed everything.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: You told me the inner drawer was the thing. The file says nothing was missing.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: The file is wrong. You knew the file was wrong before I opened my mouth.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: I knew. I didn't know you knew.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: He takes it the way he takes everything: a line in a ledger he balanced weeks ago.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: Nine months of names, Reyes. Marek started it and Iris kept it and Bo was going to carry it out of here in a folder at nine in the morning.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: And the two of them before him?

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: You already cleared those. That is the part I would like you to sit with.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: He walks out ahead of the uniform, because he has done it before and knows the pace. The ledger turns up in a locker at the bus terminal on Thursday.

lines.label: ending_clean
lines.en: [questions_left] questions still on the board, and one you never asked in three nights: who was paying him to be patient.

lines.label: ending_right_wrong_reason
lines.en: You get the name right and the reason wrong, and some lawyer gets a year out of the difference.

lines.label: ending_right_wrong_reason
lines.en: It holds. Barely. The captain signs it without looking at you.

lines.label: ending_wrong
lines.en: The name you said goes on the sheet. The thing nobody was told stays a thing nobody was told.

lines.label: ending_wrong
lines.en: Captain says that's the case, Reyes. Captain says go home.

lines.label: epilogue
lines.en: Case closed: [b][CASE['title']][/b].

lines.label: epilogue
lines.en: Case filed open: [b][CASE['title']][/b].

lines.label: epilogue
lines.en: Reyes catches the next one [_next['night']]. There is always a next one.

lines.label: epilogue
lines.en: Three nights, three files, and a club that will be a phone shop by spring.

lines.label: epilogue
lines.en: You got all three. Nobody hands you anything for that. You did not expect them to.

lines.label: epilogue
lines.en: You got [len(cases_cleared)] of [CASE_COUNT]. The rest sit in a drawer with your name on the tab.

lines.label: epilogue
lines.en: [b]Confession Room[/b] — end of run.
